scope: 2017 source frozen SVM MeanOpposition Top25%, all 200 routed APKs
host_set: exact frozen C43 callers to selected Role31 endpoint edges, including DEX-defined SDK callers irrespective of external flag; no expansion or filtering
control_definition: sensitive invoke postdominates at least one conditional successor but not the branch, and at least one other conditional successor cannot reach that invoke
cfg_scope: instruction CFG; uncaught potentially throwing instructions have an explicit exceptional-exit successor; catch handlers and reachable cycles are UNKNOWN in v1
permission_scope: unique local symbolic checkSelfPermission result, move-result and register moves, equality/inequality against PERMISSION_GRANTED=0, controlling branch and no branch bypass; resolved framework dispatch required
permission_dispatch: invoke-super to resolved framework implementation, or final app class this receiver with no app override on the resolved superclass chain; other targets PARTIAL
unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN and PARTIAL never become NO_GUARD or a class-direction feature
on_pass: permit specification of a separate source-only conditional incremental experiment; never launch training in this package
on_fail: stop this version, report all missing/unknown reasons; no threshold relaxation, no class-driven sample removal
claim_boundary: proofs concern decoded local program structure under stated DEX/framework contracts; not runtime execution, consent, data purpose or benign/malicious classification
